newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes flat on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes flat on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed flat at 1.0246 per greenback on continued dollar inflows in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
The Central Bank bought dollars at 1.0245 real per greenback to drain excess dollars from the market in the late afternoon.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial foreign exchange contracts showed a Tuesday surplus of $150 million. So far this month, the dollar flows have posted a $1.088 billion surplus.
Dealers expected the calm to continue in trade on Wednesday.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real ended steady at 1.0302 per dollar.

In the illegal parallel market, the real fell 0.29 percent to close at 1.050 real per greenback, due to a combination between an increase in the demand and a reduction of supply of dollars, traders said.
